base.free_volume: Great choice! Moderate grades, rest ≥2min. Focus on movement quality.
base.free_projecting: In Base, volume is better. If you want to try hard, max 3-4 attempts at your limit.
base.free_endurance: Perfect for Base. Keep the pump low.
base.free_technique: Ideal. Every boulder is a chance to improve your footwork.
base.free_lead_volume: Great choice! Moderate routes, long rest. Build your aerobic base.
base.free_lead_projecting: In Base, route volume is better. If you want to project, max 2-3 attempts.
base.free_lead_endurance: Perfect. Long easy routes, build endurance.

strength_power.free_volume: OK, but don't overdo the volume — save your fingers for max hangs.
strength_power.free_projecting: Ideal phase! Rest long (5-8min), maximum quality.
strength_power.free_endurance: Better after S&P work, not before. Keep it light.
strength_power.free_technique: Always useful, but don't tire yourself before strength work.
strength_power.free_lead_volume: OK, but don't overdo it — save energy for strength work.
strength_power.free_lead_projecting: Ideal phase for projects! Rest long between attempts.
strength_power.free_lead_endurance: Better as a recovery day. Not before strength work.

power_endurance.free_volume: Good choice, complements PE work. Moderate grades, steady pace.
power_endurance.free_projecting: OK if you've recovered from PE work. Otherwise go for volume.
power_endurance.free_endurance: Perfect, this is your bread and butter in this phase.
power_endurance.free_lead_projecting: OK if you're fresh. Otherwise moderate routes.
power_endurance.free_lead_endurance: Perfect for this phase. Steady pace.

performance.free_volume: Reduce volume by 30%. Your body is sharpening.
performance.free_projecting: Yes! But only when 100% fresh. Few attempts, maximum quality.
performance.free_endurance: Keep it light. Don't fatigue the systems before performance.
performance.free_lead_volume: Reduce volume. Your body is sharpening.
performance.free_lead_projecting: Yes! This is your moment. Fresh and focused.
performance.free_lead_endurance: Keep it light. Don't tire yourself before performance.

deload.free_volume: Max 10-12 boulders, easy grades. Move with pleasure, zero effort.
deload.free_projecting: No projecting in deload. Light volume or technique instead.
deload.free_endurance: Light is OK. If you feel pump, stop.
deload.free_lead_volume: Max 4-5 routes, easy grades. Move with pleasure.
deload.free_lead_projecting: No projecting in deload. Easy, fun routes only.
deload.free_lead_endurance: Light is OK. Stop if you feel fatigue.

free_mode_tips.base: Base phase: climb a lot, climb easy. Grades at -2/-3 from your max. Rest ≥2min. If you're getting pumped, you're going too hard.
free_mode_tips.strength_power: Strength & Power phase: try your limit, but rest long (5-8 min) and don't push beyond 3-4 attempts per boulder.
free_mode_tips.power_endurance: Power Endurance phase: volume with rhythm. Moderate boulders, short rest (1-2 min), seek controlled pump.
free_mode_tips.performance: Performance phase: climb how you feel. Your body is ready. Listen to it.
free_mode_tips.deload: Deload: climb for pleasure. Easy grades, zero effort, enjoy the movement.
